message.content:
Redesign the Game Servers page per the owner's board Idea "Game Servers page". Work ONLY in `/opt/nxeon-wt-gamepage` (branch feature/idea-gamepage). Commit + push. Do NOT run npm build/prisma — write code + `npx tsc --noEmit`. Theme = navy/violet/cyan glass, Geist, shared primitives.

## The idea (LOOK at the references first)
Read `/tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/ideas-refs/gameservers.png` and `.../gameservers_1.png` — the owner's desired direction. The card says: "a carousel of game covers with specs, interactive to see player counts." So build a premium **game-cover carousel/showcase**: each supported game (minecraft, valheim, rust, palworld, cs2, terraria) as a cover card with its logo/art (reuse the existing `GameLogo` component + per-game brand color from GAME_META), key specs (RAM/slots/from-price, DB-fed from db.gamePlan), and an interactive element (e.g. hover/selected state that reveals more detail; if a live player-count source exists reuse it, otherwise a tasteful static "up to N slots" — do NOT invent live player numbers).

## Which page
Determine from the references whether this is the MARKETING `/game-servers` page (app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx) or the customer deploy — most likely the marketing page (public game-servers hosting page). Enhance THAT page with the carousel/showcase as a hero or feature section, keeping the existing plan/pricing content + the lander treatment already there (price anchor, ReviewBadges). If the reference clearly shows the customer game-deploy game-picker, apply the carousel styling there instead — use your judgment from the images. Keep all DB-fed prices, first-month-free stays hosting-only (none on game), no invented stats.

## Build quality
A real carousel/slider (CSS scroll-snap or a lightweight JS carousel — no heavy deps; there's no motion lib) with game covers, brand-color glow per game, specs, and interactivity (hover reveal / selected detail). Mobile-friendly (horizontal scroll-snap). Reuse GameLogo (owner's real logos), Section/primitives, grad-text. motion-safe animations.

## Rules
No money/charge logic. Prices DB-fed. tsc clean. Commit + push origin/feature/idea-gamepage. Report the section built + which reference you matched + confirm prices DB-fed + no invented player/stat numbers. Previews on staging.

content.text:
Done. Committed and pushed to `origin/feature/idea-gamepage`.

## What I built

**An interactive game-cover carousel** on the marketing `/game-servers` page — matching reference **`gameservers_1.png`** (the hero-style horizontal showcase of game covers with brand-color glow, an active card, and player-slot pills), not the deploy-picker.

- **New client component** `/opt/nxeon-wt-gamepage/components/marketing/showcase/GameShowcaseCarousel.tsx` — a real CSS `scroll-snap` carousel (swipe on mobile), with prev/next arrow buttons and dot indicators. Each supported title is a "cover" card built from the owner's real `GameLogo` mark on its per-game brand gradient (colors resolved from `GAME_VISUAL`), with a soft brand-color glow on the active card. The active card expands to reveal the **interactive element**: "Player slots" pills, one per DB tier that defines `slots`; clicking a pill swaps the shown "Starting at $X/mo" + RAM/vCPU/NVMe to that exact tier.
- **Page wiring** in `/opt/nxeon-wt-gamepage/app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx` — replaced the old static "Supported games" grid (which used a hardcoded `SUPPORTED` array with baked-in "$4.99/mo" strings — removed) with `showcaseGames`, built entirely from `db.gamePlan`. Kept the existing PageHero, price anchor, `ReviewBadges`/`TrustBadges`, control-panel showcase, per-game DB pricing tiers, and SEO link sections untouched.

## Confirmations
- **Prices DB-fed**: every price, slot count, RAM/CPU/disk spec comes from `db.gamePlan` tiers passed server→client. The removed hardcoded starting-price strings are gone.
- **No invented player/stat numbers**: the "players" interactivity is DB slot tiers, not live player counts; slot copy is "up to N slots" as instructed.
- **First-month-free stays hosting-only** — no promo/money/charge logic added; CTAs link to `#pricing` / `/register`.
- **Theme**: navy/violet/cyan glass, `grad-text`/`card`/`btn-primary` primitives, `GameLogo`, `Section`/`SectionTitle`/`Reveal`; all animations gated behind `motion-safe:`; mobile horizontal scroll-snap.
- **`npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0.** No build/prisma run.

Preview will be on staging. Note: the Figma MCP servers flagged as needing auth were not relevant to this task.
